Volume growth was largely driven by healthy CNG/PNG- Dom volume growth of 9.1%/9.8% YoY, partly offset by a 7.5% decline in PNG-I/C volumes.
Management maintained its FY27 capex guidance of INR15-18bn, which is largely towards PNG infrastructure, with 2HFY27 expected to be capex heavy.
We moderate our YoY volume growth estimates to 7.0%/9.2% in FY27E/FY28E (previous- 8.0%/11.2%) factoring in curtailments of PNG- I/C volumes in FY27 and build in 5.6% YoY growth for FY29E.
